name: model-switcher
description: A band above the prompt for switching model and effort with one click or keypress; the model list comes from Claude Code, so it stays current.

models.title: Model chips
models.description: Comma-separated aliases or full model ids to show, in order. "all" shows every model Claude Code offers.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Comma-separated Name=model/effort pairs; empty hides them.

subagents.title: Effort applies to subagents
subagents.description: Off: the effort pick changes the main conversation only.

rememberEffort.title: Remember effort across sessions
rememberEffort.description: The model is always remembered, as /model does.
